definition: The inside part of your hand; a tall tree with big leaves at the top.
examples: She read the lines on my palm.
There are palm trees along the beach.
The coin was in the palm of his hand.

spanish.definition: Parte interior de la mano; árbol alto con hojas grandes arriba.

definition: Happening all the time; not changing.
examples: I live with constant pain.
The constant noise is driving me crazy.
Drive at a constant speed.

spanish.definition: Que pasa todo el tiempo; que no cambia.

definition: Medicine that a doctor gives you.
examples: Are you taking any medication?
She takes medication for her heart.
This medication can make you tired.

spanish.definition: Medicina que te da un médico.

definition: The force that pulls things toward the ground.
examples: Gravity makes things fall.
There's less gravity on the moon.
Water flows down because of gravity.

spanish.definition: Fuerza que atrae las cosas hacia el suelo.

definition: In or to a foreign country.
examples: She studied abroad for a year.
I've never been abroad.
They want to live abroad.

spanish.definition: En otro país o hacia otro país.

definition: A careful study of something.
examples: The lab sent the analysis of my blood.
We need a deeper analysis of the data.
Her analysis of the problem was very good.

spanish.definition: Estudio cuidadoso de algo.

definition: A strong, clear alcoholic drink.
examples: He ordered a vodka with orange juice.
Vodka is popular in Russia.
There's a bottle of vodka in the freezer.

spanish.definition: Bebida alcohólica fuerte y transparente.

examples: We put solar panels on the roof.
The earth is part of the solar system.
This light works with solar power.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con el sol.

definition: How tall someone or something is.
examples: What's your height?
The tree grew to a height of thirty feet.
I'm afraid of heights.

spanish.definition: Qué tan alto es alguien o algo.

definition: Very afraid.
examples: She's terrified of spiders.
I was terrified during the storm.
The terrified boy ran home.

spanish.definition: Con mucho miedo.

definition: A bag with a handle for carrying clothes when you travel.
examples: I still need to pack my suitcase.
Your suitcase is too heavy.
The airline lost my suitcase.

spanish.definition: Bolsa con asa para llevar ropa cuando viajas.

definition: A substance used in science or industry; related to chemistry.
examples: Don't touch those chemicals.
The factory uses dangerous chemicals.
There was a chemical reaction.

spanish.definition: Sustancia que se usa en ciencia o industria; relacionado con la química.

definition: A formal dance for high school students.
examples: Who are you going to prom with?
She bought a blue dress for the prom.
Prom is next Saturday.

spanish.definition: Baile formal para estudiantes de secundaria.

definition: A group of ships, planes or cars.
examples: The company has a fleet of trucks.
The navy sent a fleet to the area.
This airline has a new fleet of planes.

spanish.definition: Grupo de barcos, aviones o carros.

definition: A person who corrects or manages texts or movies.
examples: She's the editor of a magazine.
The editor changed my title.
He works as a video editor.

spanish.definition: Persona que corrige o maneja textos o películas.

definition: A long piece of leather used for hitting; to mix cream until it is thick.
examples: The rider used a whip.
Whip the cream for two minutes.
He whipped the horse to make it run.

spanish.definition: Tira larga de cuero para pegar; mezclar crema hasta que esté espesa.

definition: A large area of a country or of the world.
examples: This region is famous for its wine.
It rains a lot in the northern region.
They live in a mountain region.

spanish.definition: Área grande de un país o del mundo.

definition: A tendency to get angry quickly.
examples: He has a bad temper.
She lost her temper and shouted.
Try to control your temper.

spanish.definition: Tendencia a enojarse rápido.

definition: A serious talk about something.
examples: We had a long discussion about money.
The discussion ended at noon.
Let's have a discussion about your grades.

spanish.definition: Conversación seria sobre algo.

definition: To use a machine; to do surgery on someone.
examples: Do you know how to operate this machine?
The doctors operated on his heart.
The company operates in ten countries.

spanish.definition: Usar una máquina; hacerle una cirugía a alguien.

definition: The light and heat of the sun.
examples: We sat in the sunshine.
Plants need sunshine.
Florida has lots of sunshine.

spanish.definition: Luz y calor del sol.

definition: Working in secret to find information.
examples: She's an undercover police officer.
He worked undercover for three years.
It was an undercover job.

spanish.definition: Que trabaja en secreto para encontrar información.

definition: A very strong feeling of fear; a type of scary movie.
examples: I don't like horror movies.
She looked at the blood in horror.
He told us about the horror of war.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento muy fuerte de miedo; tipo de película de miedo.

definition: To break something into pieces with force.
examples: He smashed the window with a rock.
The plate smashed on the floor.
Someone is smashing bottles outside.

spanish.definition: Romper algo en pedazos con fuerza.

definition: The opposite of something.
examples: I'm not sad. On the contrary, I'm very happy.
She says it's easy, but the contrary is true.
On the contrary, the movie was great.

spanish.definition: Lo opuesto de algo.

definition: A card game people often play for money.
examples: We play poker on Fridays.
He lost a lot of money at poker.
Do you know how to play poker?

spanish.definition: Juego de cartas que se juega a menudo por dinero.

definition: Very sad, often because someone died.
examples: It was a tragic accident.
The movie has a tragic ending.
We heard the tragic news this morning.

spanish.definition: Muy triste, a menudo porque alguien murió.

definition: Shows, movies and other things that people enjoy.
examples: There's live entertainment at the hotel.
She works in the entertainment business.
What do you do for entertainment here?

spanish.definition: Shows, películas y otras cosas que la gente disfruta.

definition: The daughter of your brother or sister.
examples: My niece is five years old.
I bought a present for my niece.
She's taking care of her niece.

spanish.definition: Hija de tu hermano o hermana.

definition: A sport in which two or four players hit a ball over a net.
examples: Do you play tennis?
She won the tennis match.
We watched tennis on TV.

spanish.definition: Deporte en que dos o cuatro jugadores golpean una pelota sobre una red.

definition: A thin piece of metal for sewing or for giving medicine.
examples: I'm afraid of needles.
She used a needle and thread.
The nurse put the needle in my arm.

spanish.definition: Pieza delgada de metal para coser o para poner medicina.

definition: Following old customs.
examples: This is a traditional Mexican dish.
They had a traditional wedding.
She wore a traditional dress.

spanish.definition: Que sigue costumbres antiguas.

definition: Easy to break or to damage; needing care.
examples: Be careful with that delicate glass.
This is a delicate situation.
Baby skin is very delicate.

spanish.definition: Fácil de romper o dañar; que necesita cuidado.

definition: Free from the control of others.
examples: She's a strong, independent woman.
Brazil became an independent country in 1822.
He's independent and lives alone.

spanish.definition: Libre del control de otros.

definition: The son of your son or daughter.
examples: My grandson is learning to walk.
She took her grandson to the zoo.
He has one grandson.

spanish.definition: Hijo de tu hijo o hija.

definition: To fix something that is broken; the act of fixing something.
examples: Can you repair my bike?
The car needs repairs.
They repaired the roof last week.

spanish.definition: Arreglar algo que está roto; acción de arreglar algo.

definition: A person with an important job in a company.
examples: She's a top executive at a bank.
The executives met on Monday.
He's a sales executive.

spanish.definition: Persona con un trabajo importante en una empresa.

definition: Lack of strength; a problem in someone's character.
examples: Chocolate is my weakness.
He felt weakness in his legs.
What's your biggest weakness?

spanish.definition: Falta de fuerza; problema en el carácter de alguien.

definition: A way of doing something.
examples: This is the best method to learn English.
She has her own method of cooking rice.
We tried a new teaching method.

spanish.definition: Forma de hacer algo.

definition: An official paper that allows you to do something.
examples: You need a permit to park here.
He has a work permit.
She got her fishing permit.

spanish.definition: Papel oficial que te permite hacer algo.

definition: A piece of cloth for drying your body.
examples: Take a towel to the beach.
She dried her hair with a towel.
The towels are in the bathroom.

spanish.definition: Pedazo de tela para secarse el cuerpo.

definition: A small white flower with a yellow center.
examples: She picked a daisy in the yard.
There are daisies all over the field.
He gave her a bunch of daisies.

spanish.definition: Flor blanca pequeña con el centro amarillo.

examples: Nowadays, everyone has a phone.
Kids read less nowadays.
People travel a lot nowadays.

spanish.definition: En el tiempo presente.

definition: A small animal with eight legs.
examples: There's a spider on the wall.
She's afraid of spiders.
The spider made a web in the corner.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño con ocho patas.

definition: In or from the north.

It's cold in northern Canada.
She has a northern accent.

spanish.definition: En el norte o que viene del norte.

definition: A special way of doing something.
examples: I need to improve my swimming technique.
She learned a new cooking technique.
The artist uses an old technique.

spanish.definition: Forma especial de hacer algo.

definition: In a soft and careful way.
examples: She gently touched his face.
Hold the baby gently.
Close the door gently, please.

spanish.definition: De forma suave y cuidadosa.

definition: A U.S. police officer who works for a court; a sheriff in the old West.
examples: The marshal arrested the man.
He became a U.S. marshal in Texas.
In the movie, the marshal saves the town.

spanish.definition: Policía de EE. UU. que trabaja para un tribunal; sheriff del viejo Oeste.

definition: Rubbing a person's body to help them relax; to rub someone's body in this way.
examples: I need a good massage.
She massaged my back.
He got a foot massage at the hotel.

spanish.definition: Frotar el cuerpo de una persona para que se relaje; frotarlo de esta forma.

definition: A list of food in a restaurant; a list of options on a computer.
examples: Can I see the menu, please?
What's on the menu tonight?
Open the menu at the top of the screen.

spanish.definition: Lista de comida en un restaurante; lista de opciones en una computadora.

examples: The horses pulled the wagon up the hill.
The boy put his toys in a red wagon.
They crossed the country in a wagon.

spanish.definition: Vehículo de cuatro ruedas tirado por un caballo; carrito de juguete.

definition: A short performance to get a job as an actor or singer.
examples: I have an audition tomorrow.
She went to an audition for a TV show.
He was nervous at the audition.

spanish.definition: Actuación corta para conseguir trabajo como actor o cantante.

definition: A place where people play games for money.
examples: They lost a lot of money at the casino.
There are many casinos in Las Vegas.
He works at a casino.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde la gente juega por dinero.

definition: Salty meat from a pig, cut in thin pieces.
examples: I had bacon and eggs for breakfast.
The kitchen smells like bacon.
Do you want bacon on your burger?

spanish.definition: Carne salada de cerdo, cortada en pedazos delgados.

definition: A move to a better job in a company; an action to help sell something.
examples: I got a promotion at work.
She's hoping for a promotion this year.
There's a special promotion on shoes.

spanish.definition: Pasar a un mejor trabajo en una empresa; acción para vender algo.

examples: Click on the link.
I heard the click of the door.
She clicked the button twice.

spanish.definition: Presionar un botón del mouse; sonido corto y seco.

definition: The act of forgiving someone.
examples: He asked for her forgiveness.
Forgiveness isn't easy.
I'm not asking for forgiveness.

spanish.definition: Acción de perdonar a alguien.

definition: Lasting forever or for a very long time.
examples: She's looking for a permanent job.
The accident caused permanent damage.
This pen makes permanent marks.

spanish.definition: Que dura para siempre o mucho tiempo.

definition: To get involved in something that isn't your business.
examples: Don't interfere in my life.
My mother always interferes.
Work shouldn't interfere with your family time.

spanish.definition: Meterse en algo que no es tu asunto.

definition: With a lot of sun.
examples: It's a sunny day.
We sat in a sunny room.
It'll be sunny tomorrow.

spanish.definition: Con mucho sol.

definition: Not right or equal.
examples: That's so unfair!
It's unfair to blame her.
The new rule is unfair to students.

spanish.definition: Que no es correcto ni igual para todos.

definition: A family member who lived a long time ago.
examples: My ancestors came from Italy.
Her ancestors were farmers.
We visited the land of our ancestors.

spanish.definition: Familiar que vivió hace mucho tiempo.

definition: Showing good manners.
examples: She's very polite to everyone.
It isn't polite to talk with your mouth full.
He gave a polite answer.

spanish.definition: Que muestra buenos modales.

definition: To make food or drink go down your throat.
examples: It hurts when I swallow.
He swallowed the pill with water.
The dog swallowed a small toy.

spanish.definition: Hacer pasar comida o bebida por la garganta.

definition: To do or organize something; to lead a group of musicians.
examples: They conducted a survey of students.
She conducts the city orchestra.
The police are conducting an investigation.

spanish.definition: Hacer u organizar algo; dirigir a un grupo de músicos.

definition: A large cloth on a bed; a piece of paper.
examples: I changed the sheets this morning.
Give me a sheet of paper.
She pulled the sheet over her head.

spanish.definition: Tela grande en una cama; pedazo de papel.

definition: A wide street in a city.
examples: The hotel is on Fifth Avenue.
Turn left on the next avenue.
There are many shops along this avenue.

spanish.definition: Calle ancha en una ciudad.

definition: To change something to the opposite; the gear that moves a car backward.
examples: The judge reversed the decision.
Put the car in reverse.
We reversed the order of the songs.

spanish.definition: Cambiar algo a lo opuesto; marcha que mueve un carro hacia atrás.

definition: Money you put into something to earn more.
examples: A house is a good investment.
We made a big investment in the company.
Education is an investment in your future.

spanish.definition: Dinero que pones en algo para ganar más.

definition: Very silly; not reasonable.
examples: That's an absurd idea.
Don't be absurd.
The price is absurd.

spanish.definition: Muy tonto; sin sentido.

definition: A large farm with cows or horses.
examples: He grew up on a ranch in Texas.
They own a horse ranch.
The ranch has five hundred cows.

spanish.definition: Finca grande con vacas o caballos.

definition: A secret plan by a group to do something bad.
examples: He believes every conspiracy theory.
The men were part of a conspiracy.
The police discovered a conspiracy against the president.

spanish.definition: Plan secreto de un grupo para hacer algo malo.

definition: A person who protects someone; an adult who legally cares for a child.
examples: His aunt became his guardian.
She believes in guardian angels.
A parent or guardian must sign this form.

spanish.definition: Persona que protege a alguien; adulto que cuida legalmente a un niño.

definition: A story that may not be true.
examples: Don't listen to that rumor.
There's a rumor about the boss.
Who started this rumor?

spanish.definition: Historia que puede no ser cierta.

definition: The gray powder that remains after something burns.
examples: There was ash all over the car.
He dropped ash from his cigarette.
We scattered his ashes at sea.

spanish.definition: Polvo gris que queda cuando algo se quema.

definition: Very strong fear; violence used to make people afraid.
examples: She screamed in terror.
The city lived in terror for months.
The news talked about a terror attack.

spanish.definition: Miedo muy fuerte; violencia para asustar a la gente.

definition: A situation in which someone doesn't understand correctly.
examples: It was all a misunderstanding.
Let's talk to avoid any misunderstanding.
There was a misunderstanding about the date.

spanish.definition: Situación en que alguien no entiende bien.

definition: People walking or riding down a street to celebrate.
examples: We watched the parade on Main Street.
The town has a parade every July.
The band marched in the parade.

spanish.definition: Personas que caminan o van por la calle para celebrar.

definition: The body's ability to fight a disease; legal protection.
examples: Vaccines give you immunity.
She has no immunity to this virus.
He got immunity for helping the police.

spanish.definition: Capacidad del cuerpo de luchar contra una enfermedad; protección legal.

definition: A small, white, shiny ball used in jewelry.
examples: She wore a pearl necklace.
These pearls are very expensive.
He found a pearl in the shell.

spanish.definition: Bola pequeña, blanca y brillante que se usa en joyas.

definition: A game in which two teams kick a ball into a goal.
examples: We play soccer after school.
Soccer is very popular in Brazil.
My son is on the soccer team.

spanish.definition: Juego en que dos equipos patean un balón a un arco.

definition: Something more important than other things.
examples: My family is my first priority.
Safety is our top priority.
You need to set your priorities.

spanish.definition: Algo más importante que otras cosas.

definition: The part of a plant under the ground; the origin of something.
examples: The tree has deep roots.
Money is the root of the problem.
I'm proud of my Mexican roots.

spanish.definition: Parte de una planta bajo la tierra; origen de algo.

definition: A serious disagreement or fight.
examples: There's a conflict between the two countries.
She tries to avoid conflict at work.
The conflict lasted ten years.

spanish.definition: Desacuerdo o pelea seria.

definition: A small, round, red fruit.
examples: There's a cherry on top of the cake.
I bought a pound of cherries.
We planted a cherry tree.

spanish.definition: Fruta pequeña, redonda y roja.

definition: A party or event for a happy reason.
examples: We had a birthday celebration for her.
This calls for a celebration!
The New Year celebration was great.

spanish.definition: Fiesta o evento por un motivo feliz.

definition: Painful.
examples: I have a sore throat.
My legs are sore from running.
He has a sore back.

spanish.definition: Que duele.

definition: Not awake; not able to see or feel because of an injury.
examples: He was unconscious when they found him.
The ball hit her and she fell unconscious.
The man was unconscious for an hour.

spanish.definition: Que no está despierto; que no puede ver ni sentir por una herida.

definition: Cows and bulls on a farm.
examples: The cattle are in the field.
He raises cattle in Montana.
They sold fifty head of cattle.

spanish.definition: Vacas y toros de una finca.

definition: Dangerous energy from some substances; a treatment for cancer.

She needs radiation for her cancer.
Too much radiation can kill you.

spanish.definition: Energía peligrosa de algunas sustancias; tratamiento para el cáncer.

definition: One of the two organs you use to breathe.
examples: Smoking is bad for your lungs.
He has lung cancer.
She screamed at the top of her lungs.

spanish.definition: Uno de los dos órganos con los que respiras.

definition: To put your name on an official list; a machine in a store for money.
examples: Register for the class online.
You must register your car.
The money is in the cash register.

spanish.definition: Poner tu nombre en una lista oficial; máquina de dinero en una tienda.

definition: Exactly; for one special reason.
examples: I specifically told you not to come.
This book is written specifically for kids.
He asked specifically for you.

spanish.definition: Exactamente; por una razón especial.

definition: Perfect; the best possible.
examples: This is the ideal place for a picnic.
He's the ideal man for the job.
In an ideal world, nobody is hungry.

spanish.definition: Perfecto; lo mejor posible.

definition: An animal with a hard shell that lives in or near water.
examples: We saw a turtle on the beach.
Turtles can live for a very long time.
My son has a pet turtle.

spanish.definition: Animal con caparazón duro que vive en el agua o cerca de ella.

definition: To ruin something; to give a child too much; to go bad.
examples: Don't spoil the ending of the movie!
Grandparents love to spoil their grandchildren.
The milk spoiled in the heat.

spanish.definition: Dañar algo; darle demasiado a un niño; echarse a perder.

definition: A person who wants a job or wants to be elected.
examples: She's the best candidate for the job.
Which candidate will you vote for?
There are three candidates for mayor.

spanish.definition: Persona que quiere un trabajo o quiere ser elegida.

definition: To break apart with a loud noise and force.
examples: The bomb exploded at noon.
The car exploded after the crash.
He almost exploded with anger.

spanish.definition: Romperse con mucho ruido y fuerza.

definition: Happening right now; closest in place or family.
examples: We need an immediate answer.
He needs immediate help.
Only my immediate family came.

spanish.definition: Que pasa ahora mismo; lo más cercano en lugar o familia.

definition: The need or feeling of wanting food.
examples: Many children die of hunger.
He felt a strong hunger after the walk.
This snack will satisfy your hunger.

spanish.definition: Necesidad o sensación de querer comida.
